title: "Open" on All branches switches branch while this branch's entries still wait to be sent
what: The branch list at the top refuses to open another branch while entries saved on this device are still waiting to be sent, because the other branch's panel would not send them. The "Open" buttons on the All branches page and the "Open <new branch>" button after adding a branch switch at once with no such check, so those entries stay unsent until the owner comes back to the first branch.
expected: Every way of opening another branch waits until this branch's entries are sent, and says so with the same words as the top list.
how_often: whenever an owner opens another branch from these buttons with entries waiting
fix_line: Check for waiting entries before every branch switch, not only in the top list

title: All branches tells an owner who cannot open other branches that the gym has one branch
what: The page shows "One branch" and "Your gym has one branch. Add another in Settings → Branches." whenever the person may not open other branches, even when the gym has two or more. An owner whose key cannot open the others (or a desk person who types the address) is told something untrue and sent to add a branch that already exists.
expected: When the gym has more than one branch but this person cannot open them, the page says that, in plain words, instead of saying there is one branch.
how_often: rare: only when the person cannot open the other branches
fix_line: Show different words when there are branches but no right to open them

title: Member search on All branches stops at 50 results without saying so
what: "Find a member in any branch" returns at most 50 members and then stops, with no line saying there are more. The lists above it say "And N more", the search does not, so for a common name the owner can miss a member of a later branch and think they are not a member.
expected: The search says when there are more matches than shown, or shows them all.
how_often: when 50 or more members match the typed letters
fix_line: Add an "and N more, type more letters" line under the search
